hypothesis: CatBoost ordered boosting retains seed-specific variance in the exact component-C recipe. A fixed three-seed uniform bag may reduce that variance without changing data, features, routing, or calibration.

relationship_to_prior_work.prior_2024_runs: Single-seed diagnostics exist for a weaker non-TrackMan V3 outcome recipe, but no seed ensemble and no 2020/2021 exact-C source test exists.
relationship_to_prior_work.not_a_retune: The exact-C feature recipe and all CatBoost hyperparameters except random_seed remain frozen.
relationship_to_prior_work.direct_current_state_duplicate_avoided: Direct pitchmix/current-state exact-C features were already tested in V3/V4/V5 and are not repeated here.

candidate.selection: none; arithmetic probability mean fixed before source metrics

source_gate.on_pass: Freeze the uniform three-seed recipe, then build 2022/2023 candidate components and compare against exact parent and both honest anchors before opening 2024.
